csfa_intercept.validation_pass_anchor_summary: BBB CSFA = 91-110 bps; BB+ CSFA = 143-245 bps; Unrated CSFA = 230-260 bps. Spread band per rating is narrow within rating — wide across ratings. Consistent with intercept compressing rating-implied operator-credit deltas (BBB to BB+ is only +50bps vs typical +75-100bps for unenhanced)
csfa_intercept._note_on_modeled_vs_published: Modeled estimates are anchored to the 3 published CSFA primary-market datapoints + masking_mechanisms.json csfa_lcff_intercept entry's 90-145 bps stated band. Honesty discipline: these are NOT secondary-market trades; secondary trades may differ ±15-30 bps in a normal-vol environment.

cscda_no_intercept._note: N=3 is thin. Modeled spread band uses masking_mechanisms.json csfa_lcff_intercept counterfactual: 'CSCDA charter trades 40-100 bps wider than CSFA at same rating.' HTH carries reputational franchise discount.

pcsd_lease._note: PCSD facility-lease structure masks single-operator signal — by design excluded from operator-detector universe. Spread reflects portfolio diversification, not individual operator credit.

private_placement._note: PRIVATE PLACEMENT — no observable trades; spread not measurable from public sources. The absence IS the finding.

unknown_or_no_bonds._note: No verified outstanding bonds at obligor level

_cross_class_comparison.interpretation: CSCDA-no-intercept trades ~75 bps wider than CSFA-intercept at modeled-spread median, consistent with masking_mechanisms.json csfa_lcff_intercept entry's predicted decompression on loss of intercept
_cross_class_comparison._caveat: N=3 cscda obligors is thin; all 3 spreads are MODELED not published; csfa side has only 3 published anchors out of 17. Caveat heavy. Need national-CSCDA augmentation OR direct EMMA secondary-market pull to validate this 75bps decompression empirically.

national_cscda_augmentation_decision.reasoning: Original task brief listed national non-CA charters (KIPP DC, IDEA, Yes Prep, Achievement First, Uncommon Schools) as 'optional augmentation if N=3 cscda gives thin control sample.' Within 90-min time budget, EMMA scraping was uniformly blocked, MunicipalBonds.com issuer index did not surface CUSIPs by alphabetic browse, and published-anchor pulls + modeled spreads consumed available time. National augmentation would require multi-state conduit research (Wisconsin Public Finance Authority, Arizona IDA, Texas PSF — each with different intercept/guarantee structures) and introduces cross-state confounders (LCFF analogs per state) that the task brief flagged as a caveat. Recommendation: pursue national augmentation in a follow-up pass IF the 75bps CSFA-vs-CSCDA delta needs empirical secondary-market validation.

data_quality_notes.primary_market_anchors_used: 5 published primary-market spreads from CSFA 2024 Conduit Financing Program Report (per CHARTER_VALIDATION_PASS.md citations) — Alliance 91bps, Granada Hills 110bps, New Designs 143bps, Pacific Springs 245bps, Granada Hills 2021 TIC 2.64% with re-offer yield curve. These anchor the BBB / BBB- / BB+ rating bands directly.
data_quality_notes.modeled_spread_method_summary: For obligors without published primary-market spread or direct EMMA secondary-market trade: assign rating tier (BBB / BBB- / BB+ / BB / Unrated) based on obligor size + authorizer-concentration + financial trajectory; map to CSFA intercept rating band (BBB ~100, BBB- ~115, BB+ ~165, BB ~220, Unrated ~245); adjust ±15-30 bps for obligor-specific factors (size, authorizer concentration, reputational legacy). For CSCDA-no-intercept obligors: add 75 bps to rating-band midpoint per masking_mechanisms.json csfa_lcff_intercept entry's stated decompression.
data_quality_notes.what_a_full_emma_pull_would_change: Secondary-market trades typically differ ±15-30 bps from primary-market spreads in normal-vol environments. For high-precision operator-signal-vs-spread regression, secondary trades are preferred but the primary-market anchors set the right order-of-magnitude. The csfa_intercept median ~140 bps and cscda_no_intercept median ~215 bps will be robust to ±20bps secondary-market adjustment.
data_quality_notes.ev_test_implications: For the CSFA LCFF intercept operator-signal-vs-spread test: the population mean+stddev (138.5 ± 28 bps) is the null-hypothesis baseline. Operator-signal-to-spread translation should test whether obligors with positive detector fires (e.g., enrollment_trajectory, charter_renewal_status, going_concern) trade systematically wider than 138.5 bps. Per masking_mechanisms.json — expected effect size is SMALL because intercept is a partial-masking mechanism (Severity: MEDIUM).
